\[
I_{\text{out}}(x,y) = \mu_{k^*},
\qquad
k^* = \operatorname*{arg\,min}_{k \in \{1,\dots,9\}} \sigma_k^2
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(\mu_k\): The mean of subregion k
- \(\sigma_k^2\): The variance of the luma in subregion k

The 5x5 window around the pixel holds nine subregions: the center 3x3 square, four pentagons that point north, east, south and west, and four hexagons that point to the corners. Each pentagon and hexagon has 7 pixels, including the center. mu_k and sigma_k squared are the mean and variance of subregion k. The output is the mean of the subregion with the smallest variance.
